abstract.label: Description
abstract.value: Parsed /saisdata target1-3 into derived target features without copying raw PDB records. Manifest identifies target1 as ABL kinase with STI-571, target2 as ER-alpha LBD with 4-hydroxytamoxifen, and target3 as HIV-1 protease with cyclic urea inhibitor context. All three structures have ligand-anchored non-water HETATM pockets with pocket_confidence=1.0. Target1 is the largest and most polar/aromatic mix (548 residues, hydrophobic_ratio 0.427, polar_ratio 0.518, aromatic_ratio 0.146, span 79.06). Target2 is hydrophobic nuclear receptor-like (247 residues, hydrophobic_ratio 0.494, polar_ratio 0.466, aromatic_ratio 0.113, span 52.28). Target3 is compact protease-like (196 residues, hydrophobic_ratio 0.480, polar_ratio 0.388, aromatic_ratio 0.061, span 45.59).

detail.label: Note
detail.value: Durable implication: current targets do justify target-conditioned checks, but all are ligand-bound hydrophobic pockets. The baseline polyaromatic amide/Suzuki chemotype is plausible for hydrophobic binding across all targets; any change must preserve route validity and evaluator-friendly descriptor ranges.

abstract.label: Description
abstract.value: Audited immutable fallback baseline_result.zip using Python zipfile, common.read_submission, RDKit descriptors, route_issues, and offline evaluator tier 0. Archive member order is exactly result1.csv, result2.csv, result3.csv, result.log. Each target has five unique rows. All 15 routes have exact final-product equality to mol_smiles and no route issues. Descriptor ranges are identical across result files: MW 539.997-561.410, logP 8.843-9.348, TPSA 54.12-68.68, SA 2.4265-2.6971, route length 221-241. Tier-0 proxy: 15/15 ok, failure_count 0, mean 71.6708, min 71.5233.

detail.label: Note
detail.value: Risk summary: baseline is conservative and evaluator-friendly. Main route risk is chemical narrowness/repeated same five molecules for all targets, not validity. Molecules are lipophilic and polyaromatic but under evaluator caps for MW, logP, TPSA, rotors, rings, heavy atoms, SA, and route length.

abstract.label: Description
abstract.value: Generated a five-row-per-target archive from the existing project main.py selector using the current target PDBs. It was structurally valid, route-valid, and tier-1 ligand-prep safe: 15/15 ok, failure_count 0. Descriptor ranges shifted heavier than baseline: MW 560.426-579.256, logP 8.843-9.108, TPSA 55.13-57.78, SA 2.4265-2.7931, route length 221-245. It overlapped the baseline by two of five molecules per target.

detail.label: Note
detail.value: Rejected as final candidate because available proxy evidence is worse than fallback: tier-0/tier-1 mean 70.7123 vs baseline 71.6708, min 69.8389 vs baseline 71.5233. This is a valid negative result: target-conditioned replacement increased diversity but did not clear evaluator-risk/proxy-improvement checks.
